description: Membership Refactor - Rebrand staking to membership, remove emissions/rewards, add tier-focused UI

userStories.title: Remove ClaimDialog component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the claim rewards dialog since emissions are no longer part of the system.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove showClaimDialog state and all claim-related handlers
Remove 'Claim Rewards' button from page header

userStories.title: Remove StakeStats component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the stats component that displays pending rewards.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove StakeStats import and usage from apps/web/src/routes/stake.tsx

userStories.title: Clean up stake store - remove rewards atoms
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove rewards-related atoms from the stake store.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep all atoms needed for lock/unlock operations (stakerAtom, collectionsAtom, emissionsAtom, userStakeRecordsAtom, etc.)

userStories.title: Remove buildClaimInstructions from use-staking hook
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to remove the claim instruction builder since claiming is no longer supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep all stake/unstake instruction building functions

userStories.title: Rename stake component directory to membership
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to rename the component directory to match the new feature name.
acceptanceCriteria: Update all imports in apps/web/src/routes/stake.tsx to use @/components/membership/

userStories.title: Rename StakeDialog to LockDialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want the lock dialog to use Lock terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component name from StakeDialog to LockDialog
Change dialog title from 'Stake NFT' to 'Lock Dandy'
Update confirmation copy to 'Are you sure you want to lock this Dandy? You can unlock at any time.'

userStories.title: Rename UnstakeDialog to UnlockDialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want the unlock dialog to use Unlock terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component name from UnstakeDialog to UnlockDialog
Change dialog title from 'Unstake NFT' to 'Unlock Dandy'

userStories.title: Rename BulkStakeDialog to BulkLockDialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want the bulk lock dialog to use Lock terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component name and all internal terminology to use Lock
Update title, buttons, loading states, and toasts

userStories.title: Rename BulkUnstakeDialog to BulkUnlockDialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want the bulk unlock dialog to use Unlock terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component name and all internal terminology to use Unlock
Update title, buttons, loading states, and toasts

userStories.title: Rename StakedNftsGrid to LockedDandiesGrid
userStories.description: As a user, I want the locked NFTs grid to use Locked Dandies terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component name from StakedNftsGrid to LockedDandiesGrid
Change header from 'Your Staked NFTs' to 'Your Locked Dandies'
Change button from 'Unstake All' to 'Unlock All'
Change empty state from 'No NFTs staked yet' to 'No Dandies locked yet'
Keep 'Locked X ago' timestamp format (change from 'Staked X ago')

userStories.title: Rename AvailableToStakeGrid to AvailableToLockGrid
userStories.description: As a user, I want the available NFTs grid to use Lock terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component name from AvailableToStakeGrid to AvailableToLockGrid
Change header from 'Available to Stake' to 'Available to Lock'
Change button from 'Stake All' to 'Lock All'
Change empty state from 'No Dandies available to stake' to 'No Dandies available to lock'

userStories.title: Create MembershipStatus component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my membership tier status prominently so I understand my current benefits and progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Display large tier badge using existing TierBadge component
Show locked Dandy count (e.g., '15 Dandies Locked')
Show progress bar to next tier with percentage fill
Show 'X more for [NextTier]' text (or 'Max tier reached' for Diamond)
Show tier progression indicator: checkmarks for achieved tiers, dot for current, circles for locked
Use stakedNftCountAtom from stake store for locked count
Use TIER_THRESHOLDS from tier-badge.tsx for calculations
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Rename route from /stake to /membership
userStories.description: As a user, I want to access the membership page at /membership.
acceptanceCriteria: Update component export from StakePage to MembershipPage
Update import to use MembershipPage from routes/membership

userStories.title: Update membership page with new components
userStories.description: As a user, I want the membership page to show my tier status and use the renamed components.
acceptanceCriteria: Update all handler names: handleStake to handleLock, handleUnstake to handleUnlock, etc.
Update all state variable names: stakeDialogNft to lockDialogNft, unstakeTarget to unlockTarget, etc.
Update component imports to use renamed components (LockDialog, UnlockDialog, etc.)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Update sidebar navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the sidebar to show Membership instead of Staking.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Update tier-benefits-card link
userStories.description: As a user, I want the tier benefits card link to point to /membership.
acceptanceCriteria: Update button text from 'Stake More Dandies' to 'Lock More Dandies'
Update Diamond tier text from 'Manage Staking' to 'Manage Membership'
